title: Athena - 3D VRM AI Assistant
shortDescription: A fully integrated, autonomous 3D AI companion driven by LangGraph, Electron, Three.js, and local AI microservices.
description: Athena is an intelligent, emotionally responsive 3D avatar that lives on your desktop. Built for immersion and autonomy, Athena breaks out of the standard chatbox paradigm by featuring fully interactive 3D graphics driven by face-tracking, a localized RAG memory system, dynamic tool routing, and zero-latency local speech services. She utilizes a modular microservice architecture orchestrated via Electron IPC, ensuring a seamless and high-performance desktop experience.
myContributions: Architected a modular microservice application using Electron IPC bridging a Vite React frontend and local background services.
Developed a highly optimized custom Three.js rendering pipeline for VRM models and FBX animations ensuring buttery smooth 60 FPS.
Engineered memory management with custom deepDispose for FBX animations and GPU enforcer explicitly requesting high-performance WebGL context.
Integrated LangGraph to orchestrate tool execution allowing Athena to use web search, weather API, local timer, and localized document RAG.
Implemented zero-latency local voice stack combining Python whisper-fast for STT and Node-based SuperTonic for TTS.
Added Face/Head tracking using MediaPipe allowing Athena to maintain eye contact and blink based on webcam input.
Devised CPU throttling and LipSync math mapping audio frequencies to mouth blendshapes to reduce idle CPU overhead.

features: LangGraph Agent Engine: Powered by Google Gemini (and locally via Ollama), Athena acts as an agent, autonomously determining when to use tools.
Local Voice Stack: Lightning-fast local inference using Python whisper-fast for Speech-to-Text and Node-based SuperTonic for Text-to-Speech.
Face/Head Tracking: MediaPipe integration allows Athena to look at you, maintain eye contact, and blink naturally based on your webcam.
MCP & Tools Integration: Athena dynamically uses duckduckgo web search, weather APIs, system timers, and a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) sidecar.
Localized Document RAG: Drop PDFs into settings, and her knowledge_search tool will perform semantic vector searches against a local persistence store.
Message Replay: Review past responses instantly with a dedicated replay feature that seamlessly re-triggers TTS and animations without requiring an LLM callback.
Minimalist UI: Sleek, modern, and immersive desktop widget layout designed for a distraction-free AI presence.
challenges: Performance & Memory Management: Preventing multi-gigabyte RAM leaks over long sessions by aggressively disposing source geometry data for FBX animations.
CPU Overhead: Optimizing Audio FFT Formant analysis (for LipSync) by throttling to 20Hz while maintaining 60Hz visual interpolation, cutting idle CPU by 66%.
Port Collisions: Resolving EADDRINUSE crashes by implementing dynamic port resolution for the Python STT server and Node TTS server.
Tool Payload Adherence: Ensuring ToolMessages strictly pass required fields for Langchain Google GenAI SDK to prevent Gemini crashes.
learnings: Deepened expertise in Three.js optimizations, specifically around VRM model management and FBX animation memory disposal.
Mastered orchestrating multiple local microservices (Python and Node) seamlessly wrapped within an Electron desktop environment.
Gained extensive experience using LangGraph and Langchain for building agentic AI that autonomously decides when to use a suite of tools.
metrics: Reduced idle CPU overhead by 66% utilizing LipSync math throttling and 20Hz FFT analysis.
Maintained a steady 60 FPS 3D rendering pipeline even on lower-end systems through GPU targeting and aggressive geometry disposal.
